## Description

Optimizes institutional order liquidation trajectories by minimizing worst-case execution cost over a Wasserstein ambiguity set of multivariate Hawkes jump-diffusion arrival intensities.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, flash crash execution, liquidity shock environments.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message feeds, trade timestamps, historical volume curves.

## Caveats

Minimax robust optimization combining conic solvers with Hawkes jump-diffusion intensity estimation.
